goal: DEPTH: sub-sections / config sections in real integration with the backend — raise real coverage and capability levels
must_build: Every page in ui-spec/azure/sql.json (44 pages; nav: Overview, Activity log, Tags, Diagnose and solve problems, Getting started, Query editor (preview), Mirror database in Fabric, Settings, Data management, Integrations, Power Platform, Security, Intelligent Performance, Monitoring)
Backend: ARM Microsoft.Sql servers/databases + core (test_azure_sql_core.py): servers, databases, firewall rules, query editor if a real engine is available
List / create / detail / edit / delete round-trips through the native API the SDK and CLI use
always: Every page wired to the native API on /_wire (no static data); liveness fixtures for every list/detail page
core/capabilities/azure/sql.json: one entry per console section with an honest level + tests; tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py must pass
Capability feature ids MUST start with 'azure.' (e.g. 'azure.sql.<section>') — ids share one namespace with the AWS registry
Read the 'Cloud lenses' section of consoles/AGENT-UI.md first — use this cloud's kit, not Cloudscape

depth_targets.title: Server public network access toggle
limitations: publicNetworkAccess round-trips through ARM, but the azure-sql data-plane query wire never enforces it — a query still runs regardless of the configured setting.

depth_targets.title: "Use existing data: Sample" canned dataset load
limitations: Loads a small fixed Customer/Product/SalesOrderHeader schema with a few rows via the query data plane — not the real AdventureWorksLT sample database.

depth_targets.title: Compute + storage (service/compute tier, vCore auto-scaling, auto-pause, max size, zone redundancy)
limitations: sku and the related properties round-trip through ARM exactly as written, but Vyomi does not enforce vCore limits, auto-pause behaviour, storage caps or zone placement — the query data plane runs unchanged regardless of the configured tier.

depth_targets.title: Transparent data encryption on/off
limitations: properties.transparentDataEncryption.state round-trips through ARM, but data at rest is never actually encrypted or decrypted based on it.

depth_targets.title: System-assigned managed identity
limitations: The identity block (including a generated principalId) round-trips through ARM, but it is never actually usable for Microsoft Entra authentication to other Vyomi services.

depth_targets.title: Automatic tuning options (FORCE_LAST_GOOD_PLAN, CREATE_INDEX, DROP_INDEX)
limitations: properties.automaticTuning round-trips through ARM, but Vyomi never generates or applies tuning recommendations.

depth_targets.title: Activity log
limitations: Only console/SDK-triggered mutations made since the simulation booted are recorded (no historical backfill); severity/category filtering and the timespan picker are not modelled, and `caller` is a fixed placeholder identity rather than the real signed-in principal.

note:
DEPTH PASS (the base console is merged). Goal: turn this service's sub-sections and config sections into REAL backend integrations. For EACH capability entry listed in `depth_targets` decide:
  BUILD — Vyomi can model it in the shared core (state + native API semantics): implement it in core/<svc>_core.py (and the offline route if offline lacks it), add conformance checks in tests/conformance/, raise the entry's level in core/capabilities/<cloud>/<svc>.json (not_simulated→limited/full, config_only→limited/full where now ENFORCED, limited→full where a limitation is removed), wire the console section to it with a UI↔native-API round trip in consoles/tests/smoke-<cloud>.mjs and a "live" fixture for any list/detail page.
  KEEP HONEST — only if it needs something a local simulator cannot run (a separate product, real hardware/network, billing, third-party identity): leave it NotSimulated and put the concrete reason in the entry's `limitations`.
Prefer behaviour that is ENFORCED (e.g. lifecycle rules actually expire objects, a DLQ really receives, a policy really denies) over config that is only stored. Real coverage must go UP; nothing may regress: fidelity ≥ 90%, every capability claim true on nano AND offline, smokes green. Do not edit consoles/honest-allowlist.json or .github/.
House rules: keep consoles/src/<cloud>/kit/Capability.jsx as on base (add JSON imports only), list the service ONCE in registry.js, register any NEW core in wasm/build_cores.py + wasm/nano-boot.js (own line, never inside a // comment) + core/nano_registry.py + core/nano_persist.py (tests/conformance/test_nano_core_manifest.py), unique variable names in the smoke files, 'Vyomi' as plain text, re-vendor with python3 wasm/build_cores.py, rebuild bundles, COMMIT your source.
